reason.blocker: The frozen Dryad metadata remain public, but both tested public file-download routes returned authorization errors in GitHub Actions (HTTP 403 and HTTP 401). No Dryad file content or method-performance outcome was accessed.
reason.decision: Preserve the Dryad source as the preferred three-experiment confirmatory target, but use a separately public, immutable glioma-explant tracking example for a bounded external biological-context transfer analysis that can be reproduced without credentials.

fallback_source.related_protocol: Generation of 3D ex vivo mouse- and patient-derived glioma explant slice model for integration of confocal time-lapse imaging and spatial analysis
fallback_source.reference_kind: independent TrackMate trajectory reference; not manual gold-standard tracking
fallback_source.biological_context: mouse NPA glioma explant slice time-lapse imaging
fallback_source.inference_boundary: single external glioma-explant example; descriptive technical transfer only

pre_outcome_transfer_rule.coordinate_units: use the physical-position columns exported by TrackMate; do not rescale based on method performance
pre_outcome_transfer_rule.max_speed_rationale: frozen before external scoring as the larger of the two already-selected real Stage E candidate speed gates (HeLa 1.25, GOWT1 1.5); not selected from external outcomes
pre_outcome_transfer_rule.max_link_distance_rule: max_speed_um_per_min * external frame interval in minutes
pre_outcome_transfer_rule.proposal_temperature_rule: max_link_distance / 2, matching the frozen Stage E real-domain configuration form
pre_outcome_transfer_rule.calibration_rationale: 0.25 is the already-frozen Stage E real-domain temperature scaling value; no external calibration fitting is permitted

evaluation_plan.reference_link_rule: after schema-only inspection, reconstruct links only from source trajectory identifiers and consecutive frame indices; freeze parser before any performance calculation
primary_endpoints: association_error_auprc: calibrated uncertainty versus distance confidence
link_f1: posterior-compatible frozen links versus hard nearest-neighbour links
evaluation_plan.statistics: track-cluster bootstrap may be reported as within-example sensitivity only; biological n remains 1 and no population-level inference is allowed

claim_boundary.allowed: technical transfer/agreement evidence in one independent mouse glioma explant tracking example
not_allowed: completion of the originally planned three-experiment Dryad confirmatory arm
